verified_loci: Roberts's introduction: restoring statues from a broken arm — 'to restore some statues of Polyclitus or Praxiteles of which he had but a broken arm'
Roberts: each lost lyric imagined as discovered, then translated — 'Mr. Carman’s method, apparently, has been to imagine each lost lyric as discovered, and then to translate it'
why_seated: The fragments completed as a hundred whole lyrics; Charles G. D. Roberts's introduction likens the method to restoring statues of Polyclitus or Praxiteles from a broken arm: closure as the stated method of a book.
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-11-07: "i think we need a sappho reception history ea-corpora, whatever's public. translators, scholars. theres some ground work in the archive, notes towards a future reader i believe. the seating can include everything thats publicly available as well as declared absences and pointers for material behind pay- and access- and rights-walls"; and: "sappho reception history + future reader frameworks and related".
